## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem, how to reproduce it, and the resulting behavior.
Link the issue if there is one. Note material tradeoffs or remaining limits.

## Validation

List relevant commands/results and distinguish host, Vita3K and physical Vita.
State what was not tested. For documentation-only changes, describe the review.

For performance changes, include before/after measurements, build identifiers,
map/route or camera, resolution, graphics settings, frame cap and clocks.

## Provenance

Identify external sources, versions/licenses and notices. If AI tools assisted,
describe their use and how the result was reviewed. Write "original work" when
no external source was copied or adapted.

## Requirements

- [ ] I have the rights to submit this contribution under GPL-3.0-only-compatible terms.
- [ ] External code and dependencies have their required licenses and attribution.
- [ ] This PR adds no game content, translated game output, proprietary SDK/firmware files, secrets or private dumps.
- [ ] I inspected the staged diff and ran the relevant checks, with limits reported above.
- [ ] User documentation/compatibility information is updated where applicable.
- [ ] Performance and hardware claims are supported by the stated measurements.
